title: “Trump was in bed with Jensen”: Critics balk at Huang’s wish to return to Nvidia
gist: Nvidia's ousted CEO Jensen Huang says he would be honored to return, backed by Trump, but Nvidia's board says reinstatement is not under consideration while an internal probe of Chinese spying claims continues. Watchdogs and lawmakers allege conflicts of interest among Trump, David Sacks and Howard Lutnick in loosening chip exports to China, and some Nvidia customers are reportedly turning to Google and AMD.
